sentences.en: President says it was a deliberate decision to release 'fake' growth numbers before US midterm elections.
Military leaders say presidential and legislative poll scheduled for December 6 will now take place in November 2028.

Bangladesh Bank has directed banks to ensure that the maximum exchange rate for selling cash foreign currency does not exceed the BC (Bills for Collection) selling rate, in a move aimed at stabilising the cash forex market and protecting customers.

Myanmar’s military-backed president has said his administration will not comply with all measures ordered by the UN’s top court, which last week ruled that the country’s security forces had committed genocide against Rohingyas.

Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed at least nine Palestinians in Gaza overnight, medics said, including the Hamas-appointed deputy minister of education, in a third consecutive night of air attacks despite a one-year-old ceasefire.
Jared Kushner says the “good thing” about Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza is that it can be built into “something new”.
A proposed 18 percent US tariff could push up clothing prices for American consumers, forcing them to cut spending and weakening demand for Bangladeshi garments.
The government yesterday allowed local refiners to raise the price of soybean oil by Tk 3 a litre, citing higher international prices and import costs, while palm oil rates remain unchanged.
Gold imports through Customs House Dhaka fell by more than 99 percent in three years, with industry insiders and officials blaming hiked duties, tightened baggage rules and lengthy procedures.

The government has formed a five-member inter-ministerial committee to simplify feasibility assessment requirements and remove other procedural hurdles for development projects worth more than Tk 50 crore in the social protection, women and child development, education and health sectors.
The government on Wednesday night approved the tariff structures for electricity purchases from two coal-fired power plants and a proposal to import 4.40 lakh tonnes of wheat from the United States.

The National Board of Revenue (NBR) has identified around 27,000 e-commerce businesses, most without a business identification number (BIN), for potential VAT scrutiny as part of efforts to bring online businesses into the formal tax system.

selling.def: (ditransitive) To transfer goods or provide services in exchange for money.

strikes.def: A status resulting from a batter swinging and missing a pitch, or not swinging at a pitch when the ball goes in the strike zone, or hitting a foul ball that is not caught.

administration.def: The act of administering; government of public affairs; the service rendered, or duties assumed, in conducting affairs; the conducting of any office or employment; direction.

presidential.def: Pertaining to a president or presidency.

identified.def: To establish the identity of someone or something.

opposition.def: The action of opposing or of being in conflict.

currency.def: Money or other items used to facilitate transactions.

missiles.def: Any object used as a weapon by being thrown or fired through the air, such as stone, arrow or bullet.

imports.def: Something brought in from an exterior source, especially for sale or trade.

gunfire.def: Shots from a gun or guns, typically creating loud report.

federal.def: A law-enforcement official of the FBI; a federal agent.

entrepreneurial.def: Having the spirit, attitude or qualities of an entrepreneur; enterprising.

identification.def: The act of identifying, or proving to be the same.

investigation.def: The act of investigating; the process of inquiring into or following up; research, especially patient or thorough inquiry or examination

self-interest.def: One's personal interest or advantage, especially when pursued without regard for others.

adulteration.def: The action of adulterating, being mixed with extraneous material, illicit substitution of one substance for another.

electricity.def: Originally, a property of amber and certain other nonconducting substances to attract lightweight material when rubbed, or the cause of this property; now understood to be a phenomenon caused by the distribution and movement of charged subatomic particles and their interaction with the electromagnetic field.
